pokemon.name: bulbasaur
pokemon.description: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.

pokemon.name: ivysaur
pokemon.description: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

pokemon.name: venusaur
pokemon.description: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.

pokemon.name: charmander
pokemon.description: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

pokemon.name: charmeleon
pokemon.description: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.

pokemon.name: charizard
pokemon.description: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

pokemon.name: squirtle
pokemon.description: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

pokemon.name: wartortle
pokemon.description: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.

pokemon.name: blastoise
pokemon.description: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

pokemon.name: caterpie
pokemon.description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

pokemon.name: metapod
pokemon.description: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve. It stays motionless in the shell.

pokemon.name: butterfree
pokemon.description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

pokemon.name: weedle
pokemon.description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

pokemon.name: kakuna
pokemon.description: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

pokemon.name: beedrill
pokemon.description: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

pokemon.name: pidgey
pokemon.description: It usually hides in tall grass. Because it dislikes fighting, it protects itself by kicking up sand.

pokemon.name: pidgeotto
pokemon.description: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distinguish the movements of its prey.

pokemon.name: pidgeot
pokemon.description: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.

pokemon.name: rattata
pokemon.description: It eats anything. Wherever food is available, it will settle down and produce offspring continuously.

pokemon.name: raticate
pokemon.description: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnawing on them.

pokemon.name: spearow
pokemon.description: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

pokemon.name: fearow
pokemon.description: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

pokemon.name: ekans
pokemon.description: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

pokemon.name: arbok
pokemon.description: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.

pokemon.name: pikachu
pokemon.description: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

pokemon.name: raichu
pokemon.description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

pokemon.name: sandshrew
pokemon.description: If it fell from a great height, this Pokémon could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

pokemon.name: sandslash
pokemon.description: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.

pokemon.name: nidoran-f
pokemon.description: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.

pokemon.name: nidorina
pokemon.description: When feeding its young, it first chews the food into a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.

pokemon.name: nidoqueen
pokemon.description: Its body is covered with needle-like scales. It never shows signs of shrinking from any attack.

pokemon.name: nidoran-m
pokemon.description: It is small, but its horn is filled with poison. It charges then stabs with the horn to inject poison.

pokemon.name: nidorino
pokemon.description: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

pokemon.name: nidoking
pokemon.description: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.

pokemon.name: clefairy
pokemon.description: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

pokemon.name: clefable
pokemon.description: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

pokemon.name: vulpix
pokemon.description: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

pokemon.name: ninetales
pokemon.description: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

pokemon.name: jigglypuff
pokemon.description: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

pokemon.name: wigglytuff
pokemon.description: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.

pokemon.name: zubat
pokemon.description: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echolocation to flit about in darkness.

pokemon.name: golbat
pokemon.description: However hard its victim’s hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.

pokemon.name: oddish
pokemon.description: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.

pokemon.name: gloom
pokemon.description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

pokemon.name: vileplume
pokemon.description: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

pokemon.name: paras
pokemon.description: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

pokemon.name: parasect
pokemon.description: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushroom on its back.

pokemon.name: venonat
pokemon.description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

pokemon.name: venomoth
pokemon.description: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poisonous powder all around.

pokemon.name: diglett
pokemon.description: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

pokemon.name: dugtrio
pokemon.description: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

pokemon.name: meowth
pokemon.description: It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.

pokemon.name: persian
pokemon.description: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.

pokemon.name: psyduck
pokemon.description: It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

pokemon.name: golduck
pokemon.description: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

pokemon.name: mankey
pokemon.description: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

pokemon.name: primeape
pokemon.description: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

pokemon.name: growlithe
pokemon.description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

pokemon.name: arcanine
pokemon.description: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

pokemon.name: poliwag
pokemon.description: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.

pokemon.name: poliwhirl
pokemon.description: The swirl on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.

pokemon.name: poliwrath
pokemon.description: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.

pokemon.name: abra
pokemon.description: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.

pokemon.name: kadabra
pokemon.description: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.

pokemon.name: alakazam
pokemon.description: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.

pokemon.name: machop
pokemon.description: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

pokemon.name: machoke
pokemon.description: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

pokemon.name: machamp
pokemon.description: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

pokemon.name: bellsprout
pokemon.description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

pokemon.name: weepinbell
pokemon.description: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

pokemon.name: victreebel
pokemon.description: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

pokemon.name: tentacool
pokemon.description: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.

pokemon.name: tentacruel
pokemon.description: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to constrict its prey and enemies.

pokemon.name: geodude
pokemon.description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

pokemon.name: graveler
pokemon.description: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

pokemon.name: golem
pokemon.description: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hardens and crumbles away.

pokemon.name: ponyta
pokemon.description: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

pokemon.name: rapidash
pokemon.description: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

pokemon.name: slowpoke
pokemon.description: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.

pokemon.name: slowbro
pokemon.description: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary SLOWPOKE.

pokemon.name: magnemite
pokemon.description: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach Trainers if they are using their Pokégear.

pokemon.name: magneton
pokemon.description: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

pokemon.name: farfetchd
pokemon.description: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant stalks grow, it uses its own stalk to thwart them.

pokemon.name: doduo
pokemon.description: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

pokemon.name: dodrio
pokemon.description: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

pokemon.name: seel
pokemon.description: Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.

pokemon.name: dewgong
pokemon.description: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.

pokemon.name: grimer
pokemon.description: As it moves, it loses bits of its body, from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.

pokemon.name: muk
pokemon.description: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

pokemon.name: shellder
pokemon.description: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

pokemon.name: cloyster
pokemon.description: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

pokemon.name: gastly
pokemon.description: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

pokemon.name: haunter
pokemon.description: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.

pokemon.name: gengar
pokemon.description: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.

pokemon.name: onix
pokemon.description: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.

pokemon.name: drowzee
pokemon.description: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.

pokemon.name: hypno
pokemon.description: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.

pokemon.name: krabby
pokemon.description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

pokemon.name: kingler
pokemon.description: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer’s size makes it difficult to aim properly.

pokemon.name: voltorb
pokemon.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

pokemon.name: electrode
pokemon.description: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

pokemon.name: exeggcute
pokemon.description: Their shells are very durable. Even if they crack, they can survive without spilling their contents.

pokemon.name: exeggutor
pokemon.description: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.

pokemon.name: cubone
pokemon.description: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

pokemon.name: marowak
pokemon.description: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

pokemon.name: hitmonlee
pokemon.description: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

pokemon.name: hitmonchan
pokemon.description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

pokemon.name: lickitung
pokemon.description: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deftly manipulated.

pokemon.name: koffing
pokemon.description: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

pokemon.name: weezing
pokemon.description: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

pokemon.name: rhyhorn
pokemon.description: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

pokemon.name: rhydon
pokemon.description: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.

pokemon.name: chansey
pokemon.description: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

pokemon.name: tangela
pokemon.description: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.

pokemon.name: kangaskhan
pokemon.description: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

pokemon.name: horsea
pokemon.description: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its well-developed dorsal fin.

pokemon.name: seadra
pokemon.description: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.

pokemon.name: goldeen
pokemon.description: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

pokemon.name: seaking
pokemon.description: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

pokemon.name: staryu
pokemon.description: At night, the middle of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

pokemon.name: starmie
pokemon.description: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

pokemon.name: mr-mime
pokemon.description: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.

pokemon.name: scyther
pokemon.description: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

pokemon.name: jynx
pokemon.description: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

pokemon.name: electabuzz
pokemon.description: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.

pokemon.name: magmar
pokemon.description: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

pokemon.name: pinsir
pokemon.description: With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.

pokemon.name: tauros
pokemon.description: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

pokemon.name: magikarp
pokemon.description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but usually not more than seven feet.

pokemon.name: gyarados
pokemon.description: They say that during past strife, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.

pokemon.name: lapras
pokemon.description: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

pokemon.name: ditto
pokemon.description: It can transform into anything. When it sleeps, it changes into a stone to avoid being attacked.

pokemon.name: eevee
pokemon.description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

pokemon.name: vaporeon
pokemon.description: When VAPOREON’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

pokemon.name: jolteon
pokemon.description: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

pokemon.name: flareon
pokemon.description: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokemon.name: porygon
pokemon.description: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.

pokemon.name: omanyte
pokemon.description: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

pokemon.name: omastar
pokemon.description: Apparently, it cracked SHELLDER’s shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.

pokemon.name: kabuto
pokemon.description: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

pokemon.name: kabutops
pokemon.description: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

pokemon.name: aerodactyl
pokemon.description: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

pokemon.name: snorlax
pokemon.description: What sounds like its cry may actually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.

pokemon.name: articuno
pokemon.description: The magnificent, seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.

pokemon.name: zapdos
pokemon.description: This legendary bird Pokémon causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glittering wings.

pokemon.name: moltres
pokemon.description: This legendary Pokémon scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.

pokemon.name: dratini
pokemon.description: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

pokemon.name: dragonair
pokemon.description: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

pokemon.name: dragonite
pokemon.description: It is said that this Pokémon constantly flies over the immense seas and rescues drowning people.

pokemon.name: mewtwo
pokemon.description: Because its battle abilities were raised to the ultimate level, it thinks only of defeating its foes.

pokemon.name: mew
pokemon.description: Apparently, it appears only to those people who are pure of heart and have a strong desire to see it.

pokemon.name: chikorita
pokemon.description: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

pokemon.name: bayleef
pokemon.description: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

pokemon.name: meganium
pokemon.description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

pokemon.name: cyndaquil
pokemon.description: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

pokemon.name: quilava
pokemon.description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

pokemon.name: typhlosion
pokemon.description: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

pokemon.name: totodile
pokemon.description: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

pokemon.name: croconaw
pokemon.description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

pokemon.name: feraligatr
pokemon.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

pokemon.name: sentret
pokemon.description: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

pokemon.name: furret
pokemon.description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

pokemon.name: hoothoot
pokemon.description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

pokemon.name: noctowl
pokemon.description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

pokemon.name: ledyba
pokemon.description: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

pokemon.name: ledian
pokemon.description: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

pokemon.name: spinarak
pokemon.description: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

pokemon.name: ariados
pokemon.description: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.

pokemon.name: crobat
pokemon.description: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

pokemon.name: chinchou
pokemon.description: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

pokemon.name: lanturn
pokemon.description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

pokemon.name: pichu
pokemon.description: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

pokemon.name: cleffa
pokemon.description: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

pokemon.name: igglybuff
pokemon.description: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

pokemon.name: togepi
pokemon.description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

pokemon.name: togetic
pokemon.description: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.

pokemon.name: natu
pokemon.description: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

pokemon.name: xatu
pokemon.description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

pokemon.name: mareep
pokemon.description: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

pokemon.name: flaaffy
pokemon.description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

pokemon.name: ampharos
pokemon.description: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

pokemon.name: bellossom
pokemon.description: BELLOSSOM gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

pokemon.name: marill
pokemon.description: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

pokemon.name: azumarill
pokemon.description: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

pokemon.name: sudowoodo
pokemon.description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

pokemon.name: politoed
pokemon.description: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

pokemon.name: hoppip
pokemon.description: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

pokemon.name: skiploom
pokemon.description: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

pokemon.name: jumpluff
pokemon.description: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

pokemon.name: aipom
pokemon.description: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

pokemon.name: sunkern
pokemon.description: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.

pokemon.name: sunflora
pokemon.description: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

pokemon.name: yanma
pokemon.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

pokemon.name: wooper
pokemon.description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

pokemon.name: quagsire
pokemon.description: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

pokemon.name: espeon
pokemon.description: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

pokemon.name: umbreon
pokemon.description: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

pokemon.name: murkrow
pokemon.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

pokemon.name: slowking
pokemon.description: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

pokemon.name: misdreavus
pokemon.description: It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

pokemon.name: unown
pokemon.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

pokemon.name: wobbuffet
pokemon.description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

pokemon.name: girafarig
pokemon.description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

pokemon.name: pineco
pokemon.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.

pokemon.name: forretress
pokemon.description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

pokemon.name: dunsparce
pokemon.description: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

pokemon.name: gligar
pokemon.description: It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

pokemon.name: steelix
pokemon.description: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

pokemon.name: snubbull
pokemon.description: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

pokemon.name: granbull
pokemon.description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

pokemon.name: qwilfish
pokemon.description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

pokemon.name: scizor
pokemon.description: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

pokemon.name: shuckle
pokemon.description: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

pokemon.name: heracross
pokemon.description: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

pokemon.name: sneasel
pokemon.description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

pokemon.name: teddiursa
pokemon.description: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.

pokemon.name: ursaring
pokemon.description: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

pokemon.name: slugma
pokemon.description: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

pokemon.name: magcargo
pokemon.description: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

pokemon.name: swinub
pokemon.description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

pokemon.name: piloswine
pokemon.description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

pokemon.name: corsola
pokemon.description: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

pokemon.name: remoraid
pokemon.description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

pokemon.name: octillery
pokemon.description: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

pokemon.name: delibird
pokemon.description: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by its stored food.

pokemon.name: mantine
pokemon.description: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

pokemon.name: skarmory
pokemon.description: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

pokemon.name: houndour
pokemon.description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

pokemon.name: houndoom
pokemon.description: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

pokemon.name: kingdra
pokemon.description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

pokemon.name: phanpy
pokemon.description: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

pokemon.name: donphan
pokemon.description: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

pokemon.name: porygon2
pokemon.description: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can’t fly, however.

pokemon.name: stantler
pokemon.description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

pokemon.name: smeargle
pokemon.description: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

pokemon.name: tyrogue
pokemon.description: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

pokemon.name: hitmontop
pokemon.description: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you’d like.

pokemon.name: smoochum
pokemon.description: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

pokemon.name: elekid
pokemon.description: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.

pokemon.name: magby
pokemon.description: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble from its mouth and nostrils.

pokemon.name: miltank
pokemon.description: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

pokemon.name: blissey
pokemon.description: Anyone who takes even one taste of BLISSEY’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

pokemon.name: raikou
pokemon.description: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

pokemon.name: entei
pokemon.description: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

pokemon.name: suicune
pokemon.description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

pokemon.name: larvitar
pokemon.description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.

pokemon.name: pupitar
pokemon.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

pokemon.name: tyranitar
pokemon.description: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

pokemon.name: lugia
pokemon.description: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

pokemon.name: ho-oh
pokemon.description: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world’s skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

pokemon.name: celebi
pokemon.description: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

pokemon.name: treecko
pokemon.description: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

pokemon.name: grovyle
pokemon.description: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.

pokemon.name: sceptile
pokemon.description: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

pokemon.name: torchic
pokemon.description: Inside its body is a place where it keeps a small flame. Hug it! It will be as warm as a hot-water bottle.

pokemon.name: combusken
pokemon.description: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

pokemon.name: blaziken
pokemon.description: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

pokemon.name: mudkip
pokemon.description: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.

pokemon.name: marshtomp
pokemon.description: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

pokemon.name: swampert
pokemon.description: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.

pokemon.name: poochyena
pokemon.description: It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.

pokemon.name: mightyena
pokemon.description: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

pokemon.name: zigzagoon
pokemon.description: It gets interested in everything, which is why it zigs and zags. It is good at finding items.

pokemon.name: linoone
pokemon.description: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.

pokemon.name: wurmple
pokemon.description: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

pokemon.name: silcoon
pokemon.description: Having wrapped silk around the branches of a tree, it quiescently awaits evolution.

pokemon.name: beautifly
pokemon.description: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

pokemon.name: cascoon
pokemon.description: It endures attacks with patience, because the more pain before evolution, the sturdier it becomes.

pokemon.name: dustox
pokemon.description: It scatters its fine dust all over when it is attacked. It is a nocturnal Pokémon.

pokemon.name: lotad
pokemon.description: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

pokemon.name: lombre
pokemon.description: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

pokemon.name: ludicolo
pokemon.description: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

pokemon.name: seedot
pokemon.description: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

pokemon.name: nuzleaf
pokemon.description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

pokemon.name: shiftry
pokemon.description: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

pokemon.name: taillow
pokemon.description: When it gets cold, they migrate, flying over 180 miles a day. It hunts for tasty prey.

pokemon.name: swellow
pokemon.description: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

pokemon.name: wingull
pokemon.description: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

pokemon.name: pelipper
pokemon.description: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

pokemon.name: ralts
pokemon.description: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

pokemon.name: kirlia
pokemon.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

pokemon.name: gardevoir
pokemon.description: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.

pokemon.name: surskit
pokemon.description: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

pokemon.name: masquerain
pokemon.description: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction-- to and fro and sideways.

pokemon.name: shroomish
pokemon.description: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.

pokemon.name: breloom
pokemon.description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

pokemon.name: slakoth
pokemon.description: The way SLAKOTH lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

pokemon.name: vigoroth
pokemon.description: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

pokemon.name: slaking
pokemon.description: The world’s laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there’s no food left within its reach.

pokemon.name: nincada
pokemon.description: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

pokemon.name: ninjask
pokemon.description: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

pokemon.name: shedinja
pokemon.description: A strange Pokémon--it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

pokemon.name: whismur
pokemon.description: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

pokemon.name: loudred
pokemon.description: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

pokemon.name: exploud
pokemon.description: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor--or like an earthquake has struck.

pokemon.name: makuhita
pokemon.description: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

pokemon.name: hariyama
pokemon.description: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

pokemon.name: azurill
pokemon.description: Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs to grow.

pokemon.name: nosepass
pokemon.description: If two of these meet, they cannot get too close because their noses repel each other.

pokemon.name: skitty
pokemon.description: It’s adorable when it chases its own tail. It’s difficult to earn its trust.

pokemon.name: delcatty
pokemon.description: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

pokemon.name: sableye
pokemon.description: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

pokemon.name: mawile
pokemon.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

pokemon.name: aron
pokemon.description: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

pokemon.name: lairon
pokemon.description: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

pokemon.name: aggron
pokemon.description: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

pokemon.name: meditite
pokemon.description: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

pokemon.name: medicham
pokemon.description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.

pokemon.name: electrike
pokemon.description: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

pokemon.name: manectric
pokemon.description: Its nest can be found where a thunderbolt hits. It is discharging electricity from its mane.

pokemon.name: plusle
pokemon.description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

pokemon.name: minun
pokemon.description: Exposure to electricity from MINUN and PLUSLE promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

pokemon.name: volbeat
pokemon.description: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by ILLUMISE.

pokemon.name: illumise
pokemon.description: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

pokemon.name: roselia
pokemon.description: ROSELIA that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

pokemon.name: gulpin
pokemon.description: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

pokemon.name: swalot
pokemon.description: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

pokemon.name: carvanha
pokemon.description: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

pokemon.name: sharpedo
pokemon.description: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

pokemon.name: wailmer
pokemon.description: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

pokemon.name: wailord
pokemon.description: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

pokemon.name: numel
pokemon.description: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

pokemon.name: camerupt
pokemon.description: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

pokemon.name: torkoal
pokemon.description: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

pokemon.name: spoink
pokemon.description: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

pokemon.name: grumpig
pokemon.description: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

pokemon.name: spinda
pokemon.description: The chances of two SPINDA having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.

pokemon.name: trapinch
pokemon.description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

pokemon.name: vibrava
pokemon.description: It vibrates its wings vigorously, creating ultrasonic waves that cause serious headaches.

pokemon.name: flygon
pokemon.description: It is nicknamed “The Desert Spirit” because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

pokemon.name: cacnea
pokemon.description: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

pokemon.name: cacturne
pokemon.description: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

pokemon.name: swablu
pokemon.description: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

pokemon.name: altaria
pokemon.description: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.

pokemon.name: zangoose
pokemon.description: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

pokemon.name: seviper
pokemon.description: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any ZANGOOSE. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

pokemon.name: lunatone
pokemon.description: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

pokemon.name: solrock
pokemon.description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

pokemon.name: barboach
pokemon.description: BARBOACH uses its whiskers to taste things just as a person uses his or her tongue to taste things.

pokemon.name: whiscash
pokemon.description: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.

pokemon.name: corphish
pokemon.description: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

pokemon.name: crawdaunt
pokemon.description: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

pokemon.name: baltoy
pokemon.description: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some BALTOY have been seen spinning on their heads.

pokemon.name: claydol
pokemon.description: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

pokemon.name: lileep
pokemon.description: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

pokemon.name: cradily
pokemon.description: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.

pokemon.name: anorith
pokemon.description: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.

pokemon.name: armaldo
pokemon.description: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.

pokemon.name: feebas
pokemon.description: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.

pokemon.name: milotic
pokemon.description: It’s said that a glimpse of a MILOTIC and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

pokemon.name: castform
pokemon.description: This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.

pokemon.name: kecleon
pokemon.description: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

pokemon.name: shuppet
pokemon.description: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.

pokemon.name: banette
pokemon.description: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

pokemon.name: duskull
pokemon.description: If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their parents, it will spirit them away--or so it’s said.

pokemon.name: dusclops
pokemon.description: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

pokemon.name: tropius
pokemon.description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.

pokemon.name: chimecho
pokemon.description: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

pokemon.name: absol
pokemon.description: It has the ability to foretell natural disasters. Its life span is over a hundred years.

pokemon.name: wynaut
pokemon.description: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

pokemon.name: snorunt
pokemon.description: It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

pokemon.name: glalie
pokemon.description: It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere. It uses this power to freeze its foes.

pokemon.name: spheal
pokemon.description: It crosses the oceans by rolling itself on drifting ice. Fluffy fur keeps it warm when the temperature is below freezing.

pokemon.name: sealeo
pokemon.description: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

pokemon.name: walrein
pokemon.description: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

pokemon.name: clamperl
pokemon.description: When it evolves, it makes a mysterious pearl that amplifies psychic powers when it’s held.

pokemon.name: huntail
pokemon.description: It lives deep in the pitch-dark sea. It attracts prey by moving its tail in mimicry of a small animal.

pokemon.name: gorebyss
pokemon.description: Its pink body becomes more vivid with the rise of water temperatures in the springtime.

pokemon.name: relicanth
pokemon.description: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.

pokemon.name: luvdisc
pokemon.description: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a LUVDISC to someone you love.

pokemon.name: bagon
pokemon.description: Its well-developed neck muscles and ironlike head can smash boulders into pieces.

pokemon.name: shelgon
pokemon.description: It surrounds its body in an iron-hard shell to accumulate enough power to evolve.

pokemon.name: salamence
pokemon.description: It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.

pokemon.name: beldum
pokemon.description: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

pokemon.name: metang
pokemon.description: When two BELDUM fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

pokemon.name: metagross
pokemon.description: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

pokemon.name: regirock
pokemon.description: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

pokemon.name: regice
pokemon.description: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.

pokemon.name: registeel
pokemon.description: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

pokemon.name: latias
pokemon.description: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

pokemon.name: latios
pokemon.description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

pokemon.name: kyogre
pokemon.description: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with GROUDON.

pokemon.name: groudon
pokemon.description: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with KYOGRE.

pokemon.name: rayquaza
pokemon.description: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

pokemon.name: jirachi
pokemon.description: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

pokemon.name: deoxys-normal
pokemon.description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

pokemon.name: turtwig
pokemon.description: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

pokemon.name: grotle
pokemon.description: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

pokemon.name: torterra
pokemon.description: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.

pokemon.name: chimchar
pokemon.description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

pokemon.name: monferno
pokemon.description: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.

pokemon.name: infernape
pokemon.description: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

pokemon.name: piplup
pokemon.description: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

pokemon.name: prinplup
pokemon.description: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

pokemon.name: empoleon
pokemon.description: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

pokemon.name: starly
pokemon.description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

pokemon.name: staravia
pokemon.description: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

pokemon.name: staraptor
pokemon.description: When STARAVIA evolve into STARAPTOR, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

pokemon.name: bidoof
pokemon.description: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.

pokemon.name: bibarel
pokemon.description: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

pokemon.name: kricketot
pokemon.description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

pokemon.name: kricketune
pokemon.description: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

pokemon.name: shinx
pokemon.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

pokemon.name: luxio
pokemon.description: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

pokemon.name: luxray
pokemon.description: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

pokemon.name: budew
pokemon.description: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.

pokemon.name: roserade
pokemon.description: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

pokemon.name: cranidos
pokemon.description: CRANIDOS toughen up their already rock-hard heads by headbutting one another.

pokemon.name: rampardos
pokemon.description: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.

pokemon.name: shieldon
pokemon.description: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

pokemon.name: bastiodon
pokemon.description: When attacked, they form a wall. Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from the attacks.

pokemon.name: burmy
pokemon.description: It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.

pokemon.name: wormadam-plant
pokemon.description: It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

pokemon.name: mothim
pokemon.description: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the COMBEE hive.

pokemon.name: combee
pokemon.description: At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

pokemon.name: vespiquen
pokemon.description: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control COMBEE.

pokemon.name: pachirisu
pokemon.description: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

pokemon.name: buizel
pokemon.description: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

pokemon.name: floatzel
pokemon.description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

pokemon.name: cherubi
pokemon.description: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

pokemon.name: cherrim
pokemon.description: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

pokemon.name: shellos
pokemon.description: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

pokemon.name: gastrodon
pokemon.description: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.

pokemon.name: ambipom
pokemon.description: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

pokemon.name: drifloon
pokemon.description: It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

pokemon.name: drifblim
pokemon.description: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

pokemon.name: buneary
pokemon.description: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.

pokemon.name: lopunny
pokemon.description: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.

pokemon.name: mismagius
pokemon.description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

pokemon.name: honchkrow
pokemon.description: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its MURKROW followers.

pokemon.name: glameow
pokemon.description: When it’s happy, GLAMEOW demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

pokemon.name: purugly
pokemon.description: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

pokemon.name: chingling
pokemon.description: It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.

pokemon.name: stunky
pokemon.description: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

pokemon.name: skuntank
pokemon.description: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

pokemon.name: bronzor
pokemon.description: Ancient people believed that the pattern on BRONZOR’s back contained a mysterious power.

pokemon.name: bronzong
pokemon.description: Ancient people believed that petitioning BRONZONG for rain was the way to make crops grow.

pokemon.name: bonsly
pokemon.description: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

pokemon.name: mime-jr
pokemon.description: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

pokemon.name: happiny
pokemon.description: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

pokemon.name: chatot
pokemon.description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

pokemon.name: spiritomb
pokemon.description: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

pokemon.name: gible
pokemon.description: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

pokemon.name: gabite
pokemon.description: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

pokemon.name: garchomp
pokemon.description: Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

pokemon.name: munchlax
pokemon.description: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.

pokemon.name: riolu
pokemon.description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

pokemon.name: lucario
pokemon.description: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to LUCARIO, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

pokemon.name: hippopotas
pokemon.description: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

pokemon.name: hippowdon
pokemon.description: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

pokemon.name: skorupi
pokemon.description: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

pokemon.name: drapion
pokemon.description: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

pokemon.name: croagunk
pokemon.description: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower-back pain.

pokemon.name: toxicroak
pokemon.description: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

pokemon.name: carnivine
pokemon.description: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

pokemon.name: finneon
pokemon.description: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a BEAUTIFLY. At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.

pokemon.name: lumineon
pokemon.description: LUMINEON swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

pokemon.name: mantyke
pokemon.description: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.

pokemon.name: snover
pokemon.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

pokemon.name: abomasnow
pokemon.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

pokemon.name: weavile
pokemon.description: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.

pokemon.name: magnezone
pokemon.description: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed MAGNETON’s molecular structure, turning it into MAGNEZONE.

pokemon.name: lickilicky
pokemon.description: Its saliva can decompose anything. It wraps its long tongue around things to coat them with its sticky saliva.

pokemon.name: rhyperior
pokemon.description: From holes in its palms, it fires out GEODUDE. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

pokemon.name: tangrowth
pokemon.description: When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.

pokemon.name: electivire
pokemon.description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

pokemon.name: magmortar
pokemon.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

pokemon.name: togekiss
pokemon.description: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

pokemon.name: yanmega
pokemon.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

pokemon.name: leafeon
pokemon.description: When you see LEAFEON asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

pokemon.name: glaceon
pokemon.description: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.

pokemon.name: gliscor
pokemon.description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

pokemon.name: mamoswine
pokemon.description: A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

pokemon.name: porygon-z
pokemon.description: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...

pokemon.name: gallade
pokemon.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

pokemon.name: probopass
pokemon.description: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

pokemon.name: dusknoir
pokemon.description: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it.

pokemon.name: froslass
pokemon.description: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS.

pokemon.name: rotom
pokemon.description: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

pokemon.name: uxie
pokemon.description: According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

pokemon.name: mesprit
pokemon.description: This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.

pokemon.name: azelf
pokemon.description: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

pokemon.name: dialga
pokemon.description: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

pokemon.name: palkia
pokemon.description: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

pokemon.name: heatran
pokemon.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

pokemon.name: regigigas
pokemon.description: It is believed to have shaped REGIROCK, REGICE, and REGISTEEL out of clay, ice, and magma.

pokemon.name: giratina-altered
pokemon.description: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

pokemon.name: cresselia
pokemon.description: Those who sleep holding CRESSELIA’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

pokemon.name: phione
pokemon.description: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

pokemon.name: manaphy
pokemon.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

pokemon.name: darkrai
pokemon.description: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

pokemon.name: shaymin-land
pokemon.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

pokemon.name: arceus
pokemon.description: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

pokemon.name: victini
pokemon.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

pokemon.name: snivy
pokemon.description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

pokemon.name: servine
pokemon.description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

pokemon.name: serperior
pokemon.description: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

pokemon.name: tepig
pokemon.description: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

pokemon.name: pignite
pokemon.description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

pokemon.name: emboar
pokemon.description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

pokemon.name: oshawott
pokemon.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

pokemon.name: dewott
pokemon.description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

pokemon.name: samurott
pokemon.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

pokemon.name: patrat
pokemon.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

pokemon.name: watchog
pokemon.description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

pokemon.name: lillipup
pokemon.description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

pokemon.name: herdier
pokemon.description: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

pokemon.name: stoutland
pokemon.description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

pokemon.name: purrloin
pokemon.description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

pokemon.name: liepard
pokemon.description: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

pokemon.name: pansage
pokemon.description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

pokemon.name: simisage
pokemon.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

pokemon.name: pansear
pokemon.description: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

pokemon.name: simisear
pokemon.description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

pokemon.name: panpour
pokemon.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

pokemon.name: simipour
pokemon.description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

pokemon.name: munna
pokemon.description: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

pokemon.name: musharna
pokemon.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

pokemon.name: pidove
pokemon.description: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

pokemon.name: tranquill
pokemon.description: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.

pokemon.name: unfezant
pokemon.description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

pokemon.name: blitzle
pokemon.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

pokemon.name: zebstrika
pokemon.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

pokemon.name: roggenrola
pokemon.description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

pokemon.name: boldore
pokemon.description: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

pokemon.name: gigalith
pokemon.description: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

pokemon.name: woobat
pokemon.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

pokemon.name: swoobat
pokemon.description: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

pokemon.name: drilbur
pokemon.description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

pokemon.name: excadrill
pokemon.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

pokemon.name: audino
pokemon.description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

pokemon.name: timburr
pokemon.description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

pokemon.name: gurdurr
pokemon.description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

pokemon.name: conkeldurr
pokemon.description: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

pokemon.name: tympole
pokemon.description: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

pokemon.name: palpitoad
pokemon.description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

pokemon.name: seismitoad
pokemon.description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

pokemon.name: throh
pokemon.description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

pokemon.name: sawk
pokemon.description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

pokemon.name: sewaddle
pokemon.description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

pokemon.name: swadloon
pokemon.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

pokemon.name: leavanny
pokemon.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

pokemon.name: venipede
pokemon.description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

pokemon.name: whirlipede
pokemon.description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

pokemon.name: scolipede
pokemon.description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

pokemon.name: cottonee
pokemon.description: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

pokemon.name: whimsicott
pokemon.description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

pokemon.name: petilil
pokemon.description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

pokemon.name: lilligant
pokemon.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

pokemon.name: basculin-red-striped
pokemon.description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

pokemon.name: sandile
pokemon.description: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

pokemon.name: krokorok
pokemon.description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

pokemon.name: krookodile
pokemon.description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

pokemon.name: darumaka
pokemon.description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

pokemon.name: darmanitan-standard
pokemon.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

pokemon.name: maractus
pokemon.description: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

pokemon.name: dwebble
pokemon.description: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

pokemon.name: crustle
pokemon.description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

pokemon.name: scraggy
